summary: Eupraxia Pharmaceuticals filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated October 15, 2026, announcing that its RESOLVE Phase 2b trial of EP-104GI in eosinophilic esophagitis reached target enrollment of 120 patients. The open-label Phase 1b/2a and blinded Phase 2b portions have administered over 3,000 injections with no treatment-related serious adverse events. Interim analysis of the Phase 2b portion is expected December 2026. No transaction, price, stake, advisor, or board recommendation is present; this is a routine clinical-development update, not a special situation. Watch for December 2026 interim data as the key catalyst.
